description: Emergency visit for irreversible pulpitis. The safety-critical fixture: the note must record the diagnosis the dentist made, must not invent an extraction, and must not credit treatment that was not performed.

transcript.text: The top right has been throbbing since Friday night, it woke me up twice.
Yes, for ages. And it hurts when I bite down.
16 has a deep distal cavity, and it is tender to percussion. Cold test lingers well past ten seconds. No swelling, no sinus tract, no trismus.
This is irreversible pulpitis on 16. Because of the time, I'll place a temporary dressing and start root canal treatment at the next visit.
Ibuprofen 400 milligrams, three times a day with food, and paracetamol if needed. If you get facial swelling or a fever, call us or go to the hospital.
Book in for the first appointment, thirty minutes, within the week, and avoid very hot drinks.

fields.chiefComplaint: Throbbing pain upper right since Friday, waking the patient at night. Linger after cold stimulation and pain on biting.
fields.history: Nil medical history recorded that contraindicates ibuprofen. No reported allergies. Systemic health otherwise unremarkable at this visit.
fields.toothFindings: 16: deep distal cavity. Tender to percussion. Cold test produces a response that lingers well beyond ten seconds. No swelling, no sinus tract, no trismus.
fields.findingsGingival: Gingivae unrelated to the presenting complaint, no localised swelling around 16.
fields.treatmentPerformed: Temporary dressing placed to 16. Due to the time available, definitive root canal treatment has been planned for the next visit rather than commenced today.
fields.recommendations: Ibuprofen 400 mg three times daily with food. Paracetamol as required. Avoid very hot drinks. If facial swelling, fever or difficulty swallowing develop, contact the practice urgently or attend hospital.
fields.recallRequirements: Book within the week for the first thirty-minute root canal treatment appointment.

recorded.patientSummary: You attended with severe pain in the upper right. The nerve of that tooth is inflamed and cannot heal by itself, so the tooth needs root canal treatment. A temporary dressing was placed today, pain relief was discussed, and you should book the first treatment appointment this week. Warn us immediately if you get facial swelling or a fever.
